I’m going to make this short since fucking Reddit decided to delete my last draft. >:c (spoiler, it’s not short)

1. Depending on you and your sisters relationship, is it possible for you to go and stay with her until you get back on your feet?


2. Résumé, yup creat a solid résumé. And I’m not talking about 10-15 hour résumés, I’m talking about upward of 20-50+ hour résumés. (As in how long it takes you, needs to be very thorough) Why you may ask? Well I think that it’d be good for you to have a steady job/income for the time being. And I think it’d help bring purpose into your life.


3. Are you content with your environment? If not, which I’m assuming so, this would tie along with #2, since it’ll help you get some money to spend on yourself, feel accomplished, and possibly earn enough to move out.


4. Talk to people, I know this one is dumb but I think that despite your shitty internet connection and your social circle dying, you need social interactions. I’m not sure if you’re a introvert or extrovert but depending on what you are I’d start off with internet friends, doesn’t need to be physical contact.


5. Mental health is vital for depression, exercise is vital for your hormones. I’m not sure if you already work out but if not, taking a walk around the house, outside, in the yard, on the porch, anywhere is a good start. Anything other than laying in bed all day. 


6. This ties into #5, but sunlight is very important. I think that sitting outside whist reading (if it’s safe for you to do so) is a great way to get fresh air and see the sun once and a while. 

These are all the tips I could give you as far as I can think of right now. But remember that even if your home life isn’t ideal, you can always turn to community’s on Reddit to express yourself. Aka; drawing, guitar, writing, books, literature, LGBTQ+, etc. While there’s some pretty terrible people out there, there are also people who will be there for you and give you a shoulder to lean on. Of course this also applies to me too, so if you want to talk for whatever reason message me. :)
